info.name: AV Backend — complete ordered API workflow
info.description: Run folders in order, skipping optional folder 03. Pause for manual OTP entry. See postman/README.md.

item.name: 01 New user: request OTP, verify, register, bearer token

request.description: Enter a deliverable unused email. Read the code from your inbox or local dev log; set userOtp before verification.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const r=pm.response.json(); if(r.accessToken) pm.environment.set("userToken",r.accessToken); if(r.user) pm.environment.set("userId",r.user.id); }

item.name: Register verified new profile and save bearer token

request.description: Only needed when verify returned registrationRequired=true. Must run before OTP expires.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const r=pm.response.json(); if(r.accessToken) pm.environment.set("userToken",r.accessToken); if(r.user) pm.environment.set("userId",r.user.id); }

item.name: Update screen before it is locked

request.description: Run once before shows; this endpoint locks the screen. Replacement labels use row B to avoid conflicting with orphaned row A seats during persistence.

item.name: List screens and capture legacy seat IDs

request.description: Version seat IDs differ from legacy screen IDs. This workflow books legacy IDs because seat-holds currently validate legacy IDs.
Current backend marks payment VERIFIED from these fields; it has no external gateway callback endpoint.
